cases.title: A valid template has no issues
fancyTemplate other than 1 is TEMPLATE_VERSION
An unknown writer is TEMPLATE_WRITER
A missing document and an unknown key are TEMPLATE_SHAPE
cases.notes: Envelope keys in written order, then the missing one. Only `description` is allowed besides the four.

cases.title: An envelope that is not an object is TEMPLATE_SHAPE at the root
Bad declarations are DECL_INVALID at the offending key
cases.notes: One per declaration, in written order. f is an array with no `items`.

cases.title: Every unresolvable token path is TOKEN_UNDECLARED
cases.notes: An unknown variable, an unknown property, a step into a string, and a loop binding outside any loop. The path is walked through the DECLARATIONS (SPEC 6).

cases.title: A token in a field the profile does not list is TOKEN_FORBIDDEN_FIELD
A token inside an object key is TOKEN_IN_KEY
Unknown filters and bad arguments
cases.notes: Static, so an admin hears it when saving rather than when the first certificate is issued.

cases.title: Token syntax errors are reported at the field
A directive on an object that is not an array element is DIRECTIVE_MISPLACED
cases.notes: There is nothing to remove an object FROM unless it is an element of an array.

cases.title: An unknown $-key is DIRECTIVE_UNKNOWN
cases.notes: No writer model uses $-keys, so the whole namespace is reserved.

cases.title: $as alone, a shadowing $as and a non-string $each are DIRECTIVE_INVALID
A $if fancy-expr refuses is DIRECTIVE_EXPR
$if and $each naming nothing in scope are DIRECTIVE_UNDECLARED
cases.notes: fancy-expr's references() is exactly this question (expr/references), and the host -- here, this package -- decides what exists.

cases.title: $each over a declared string is DIRECTIVE_NOT_ARRAY
A loop binding is in scope inside its item and nowhere else
Issues come in document order: declarations, then document, $-keys first within an object
cases.notes: Within a token the path is reported before its filters (SPEC 11).

cases.title: A template over a size bound is reported with that one issue
cases.notes: The bound exists so an oversized template costs nothing more to refuse; reporting every other issue in it would be the cost.

cases.title: dark-slide: an image variable in an element src is allowed
cases.notes: The plan's one route for images: a declared image variable, magic-byte checked, in an image-capable field.

skip.php: The dark-slide profile is phase 6 of the plan (TS + Python legs; holy-sheet and dark-slide profiles). The PHP leg implements fine-print and last-word only; this row is the spec it will be built against.
